dedupe_keys.name: bess component detection and digital twin validation dataset

description: BESS Component Detection and Digital Twin Validation Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Venkata Balaji Anupoju, Vidya Sinha (Blekinge Institute of Technology). This record contains the YOLO-format image dataset used for Stage I component detection in an AI-driven Digital Twin framework for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) validation and troubleshooting. Version 1.1.0 contains 15,099 images and 15,099 matching label files, divided into 14,436 training images and 663 validation images. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
